# `oaap app config`

list, set or unset the configuration values of an instance.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app config [--append] [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                       {list,set,unset} name [key] [value]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | -- |
| `key` | -- |
| `value` | omit with 'set' to be prompted (hidden input) |
| `--append` | with 'set': append to the current value with ';' instead of replacing it (list-valued keys) |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `set` | yes |
| `unset` | yes |
